optimizedDescription.value: Translates Go source into package-aware declarations, scoped evidence, logical ownership, calls, imports, hierarchy, and types.

optimizedContext.value:
# go-language-adapter

## Rules

### Files & analysis
- `GoLanguageAdapter`: `.go` → `go`; parse content once via registered Tree-sitter/ast-grep grammar.
- Return complete `FileAnalysisDraft`: symbols, imports, scoped/call/reference facts, compact serializable Pass 2 state; never persist AST.
- Derive declared package from source; package identity from nearest bounded `go.mod`; `resolutionManifests()` exactly [`go.mod`], never `go.work`/other basename.

### Declarations & ranges
- Extract functions, receiver methods, structs (`SymbolKind.Class` broad kind), interfaces, named types/aliases, variables, constants, struct fields (`SymbolKind.Property`). Broad kind never complete Go identity.
- Use complete parser construct range, exact declared-name `selectionRange`, shared half-open convention; retain immediately preceding attached comments verbatim; omit candidates lacking authoritative ranges.

### Package surface & imports
- Logical declarations expose indexed Go package; uppercase Unicode-leading package identifier → public binding; lowercase → non-exported. Public identity stays package-qualified across package files.
- Extract single/grouped/aliased/dot/blank imports. Blank import → dependency evidence, no local binding. Dot import stays namespace form; bind unqualified name only with unique proven indexed target.
- Resolve import specifiers by longest known `go.mod` module prefix.

### Logical ownership
- Parse receiver type and pointer/value semantics from AST receiver parameter nodes, never regex; retain pointer/value evidence in parser state.
- Map receiver/interface syntax to logical symbols before member logical IDs. Receiver method owner = declared receiver logical identity; interface method owner = interface logical identity; normalize pointer syntax.
- Struct field owner and `parentId` = declaring struct logical identity. Package functions/types/variables/constants have no owner beyond package surface.
- Never derive owners from raw syntax IDs or optional `SymbolNode.parentId`. Omit unproven receiver-owner logical member facts. Preserve distinction between same-name methods on different receivers and interface signatures versus concrete methods.

### Bindings, calls & types
- Emit deterministic facts for import aliases, function scopes, typed parameters/results, receiver bindings, selectors, named composite literals, constructor-like calls, type references.
- Build `IMPORTS`, `CALLS`, `CONSTRUCTS`, `USES_TYPE` only from proven package aliases, receiver types, local declarations, or indexed imports.
- `buildRelations()` emits concrete `IMPORTS` for resolved packages and `CALLS` from caller declarations to target functions/receiver methods.
- Never guess unresolved selectors, reflection, unproven interface dispatch, uninstantiated generic/type-set choices, or interprocedural-flow values.

### Embedding & interface satisfaction
- Local statically named interface embedding → ordered `EXTENDS`; unsupported: embedded struct fields, cross-file embedding closure, promoted-member depth selection.
- Reference facts include child owner, embedded/contract owner, relation kind, ordered traversal steps. Reached owner must be queried for requested member; owner itself never member candidate. Cycles terminate deterministically.
- `IMPLEMENTS` allowed only when one analyzed file contains complete known interface and receiver-method facts prove every direct method, respecting pointer/value evidence.
- Never claim satisfaction for empty/unknown method set, missing method, embedded-interface requirements, build selection, unsupported generic type sets, or name-only coincidence.
- Proven owner-level `IMPLEMENTS` plus ordered step enables contract-owner traversal; query requested interface signature/concrete member under reached owner. Member-level `OVERRIDES` unsupported.

### Build boundary & capabilities
- Module identity from `go.mod`; known module subpaths by longest prefix.
- Unsupported until consumed: `go.work`, `replace`, vendoring, `internal`, build tags, `GOOS`/`GOARCH`, cgo, complete generic method sets. Dependent alternatives stay unresolved/ambiguous.
- Advertise `buildContext: false`; `hierarchy: true` only while embedding/proven method-set facts use shared hierarchy/provenance model.
- Parse failures, partial package coverage, unsupported semantics surface through shared coverage. Identical content/session context yields deterministic facts, relations, candidate ordering.

## Constraints
- MUST NOT run `go list`, compile code, retain parser ASTs, or infer runtime interface values.
- MUST NOT guess build-dependent alternatives, reflection, or interface satisfaction.
- Go-specific package, receiver, embedding, method-set semantics remain inside adapter.
